svg.title: Four Checks Before a Mandate Becomes Executable
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-statutory-and-settlement-decision-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before a Mandate Becomes Executable; subtitle: Each unresolved branch returns the transaction for correction or rejection.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Stage numbers identify sequential decision nodes, not risk scores. At each node, a documented pass advances to the next check; an unresolved result stops the affected activity. Apply current law to the transaction's actual jurisdictions and structure. An NCNDA cannot substitute for a required license.; caption: Record the evidence, reviewer, date, and resulting action for every node. Recheck after a switch from an asset sale to an equity sale, a new buyer, or changed payment instructions.; stages: label: Asset and license classification; value: Proceed only after identifying the asset and required authority.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Identify asset versus securities transfers and every relevant jurisdiction. California BPC 10130 and 10131 cover specified real-property and business-opportunity brokerage activities. If required authority is absent, stop brokerage activity until an appropriate structure exists.; label: Securities route and exclusions; value: Proceed only with a documented registration or exemption route.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: For securities transactions, test 15 U.S.C. 78o(b)(13), including current eligible-company limits, buyer control, active management, prohibited activities, and disqualifications. Required dual-representation disclosure and written consent must be documented. An asset-only conclusion requires its own recorded basis.; label: Authority, claims, and title; value: Proceed only with supported representations and releasable interests.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Verify signatory authority, agency disclosures, conflicts, and evidence behind material claims. For securities, 17 CFR 240.10b-5 addresses deceptive statements and omissions. For secured assets, apply enacted UCC 9-315 and 9-513. Scope NCNDA introductions, exclusions, duration, and remedies without treating the document as automatic protection.; label: Funds and release instructions; value: Proceed only through verified settlement and permitted funds handling.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use independent escrow and known-contact callbacks for payment changes. The M&A exemption under 15 U.S.C. 78o(b)(13) excludes specified custody activities. California BPC 10145 governs covered broker trust-money handling. If release instructions conflict, freeze disbursement and obtain corrected instructions.
